score_evidence.A: Claim-style headings, no skipped levels, real tables and fenced code, no math so no use_math; description 123 characters. Deductions: TL;DR is two dense paragraphs, L14 alone about 1,400 characters covering structured-output limits, hooks, interventions, HITL, Cedar and the Langfuse verdict; the quickstart section 'L656 설치부터 TicketTriage 객체를 돌려받는 첫 호출까지' comes after the structured-output section that already used TicketTriage, and install is given twice (L133, L665); a few topic headings (L47, L660, L1088).
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural Korean engineer prose. Deductions: L492 '인가 서비스가 예외를 던져도 환불이 막히는 핸들러입니다.' (orphan sentence; rewrite '반대로 deny를 쓰면 인가 서비스가 예외를 던져도 환불은 막힙니다.'); L1025 '서브클래싱하면 재시도 여부와 지연을 직접 정하고, 훅을 등록하는 코드는 기본 구현을 그대로 씁니다' (meaning lost; rewrite '서브클래스는 재시도 여부만 정하고 대기는 기본 구현이 넣습니다.'); L1172 '이 글의 판단으로는 다음처럼 고르면 무난합니다'; '이렇습니다' x3, 14 '할 수 있습니다'.
score_evidence.C: Reads as one document with accurate title cross-references (L1080, L1164, L1166, L1168). Deductions: L18 and L37 restate L12; L405 says '인가 훅이 취소한 호출을 톤 교정 훅이 덮어쓸 수 있습니다' though the auth check is before_tool_call and tone correction after_model_call, so they never touch the same event; L919 tells the reader to reuse the 'cedar' object from triage_with_approval although it is a local variable there; build_ticket_agent and handle_ticket are redefined with new signatures (L1067, L1075) and L1106 then calls the old zero-argument form.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get worked examples where they appear: message growth 3 -> 5 -> 6 (L69), Before/After order table (L212), four-handler decision merge (L469-L476), Guide convergence vs after_model_call's missing Deny (L482-L484), 20,000-token overshoot (L826), 124 s retry vs 20 s deadline and the 14 s fix (L994, L1000), two pods writing one session (L1086). Over-dense TL;DR front-loads mechanisms before they are explained.
score_evidence.E: Tables where comparison helps: stop reasons (L92), state lifetimes (L116), hook events (L197), callback order (L212), allowed decisions (L413), decision merge (L469), schema mapping (L555), limit outcomes (L646), checkpoints (L838), stop reason -> handling (L871), retry schedule (L985), session events (L1039), choice table (L1174); two text flow diagrams (L53, L573) labelled as illustrations. No remote images; no actual figure of the loop or span tree.
score_evidence.T2: Covers what the sources cover in a sensible order (loop -> state -> hooks -> interventions -> structured output -> quickstart -> HITL/Cedar -> limits/cancel -> concurrency -> retry -> sessions -> metrics/traces/evals -> choice). The quickstart sits mid-post after structured output; middleware (in the hooks sources) is absent.
score_evidence.T3: Explains mechanisms and why: After callbacks reversed within an order group for cleanup symmetry (L210), interventions vs hook last-write-wins (L403), decision precedence vs registration order (L427), structured output as a per-call tool with validation errors fed back (L528, L595), limit checks at iteration start (L824), cooperative cancellation (L845), no distributed lock in sessions and the two failure modes (L1084-L1086), symlink risk (L1090). Design advice is phrased as advice; failure modes at the end mostly point back.
score_evidence.F: All 15 sampled claims are supported. Off-sample: L963 '분류 객체는 정상 완료일 때만 내보냅니다' is wrong for the code it describes (successful structured output ends with stop_reason 'tool_use', classify() returns STOPPED, triage None; exercised) (-2); L919 says the cedar object gets a TicketTriage rule added, but L781 already has it and cedar is local to another function (-0.5). L836 '네 곳' is the Python count without saying so.
score_evidence.T1: Most blocks execute against SDK 1.64.0 with a scripted fake model (hooks, interventions, structured output with validation feedback and limits, HITL classifier, Cedar alice/bob, retry schedules, sessions). Deductions: the final service handle_ticket (L921) raises NameError for cedar and ask, and once patched never returns its TicketTriage; L1063 TicketRetryStrategy(...) TypeError; L1104 calls build_ticket_agent() without the ticket_id the L1067 redefinition requires; L681 needs the [anthropic] extra and Cedar the [cedar] extra, neither mentioned.
